nodes.label: Heroes / Party
nodes.description: The adventuring party fighting the centipede-like meat creature: Bonogo, Caelynn, Stafl, Karsemine, Ephanna, and Baergrom. They coordinate healing, spells, and attacks to sever the creature in two and end the final battle, then plan a long rest before the festival.

nodes.label: Seed
nodes.description: A small seed-like object found rattling inside the Wolf's head; it bears writhing small tentacles that wrap around the holder's hand and emanate dark energy as they try to burrow into skin. Stafl stabs it, triggering a lightning crack and screams from the meat creature.

The small tentacles wrap themselves around his hand and he can feel dark energy emanating from it as it tries to burrow into his skin

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:26-26
anchor_quotes: After a quick debate about what to do with the seed Stafl decides to just stab it

nodes.label: Meat Goo
nodes.description: A goo that pools on the floor of the chamber; Caelynn collects a sample of it after dumping out some of her water.

nodes.label: The Storm Is Identical to the Stone Bridge Storm
nodes.description: Caelynn's Arcana check reveals the storm raging during the final battle is exactly like the storm from Stone Bridge where Bonogo and Bubbles were almost swept away, implying a recurring or deliberate supernatural storm phenomenon tied to the party's past.

this storm is exactly like the storm they encountered in Stone Bridge when Bonogo and Bubbles were almost swept away

nodes.label: The Wolf's Head Imprisoned in the Meat Creature
nodes.description: A head materializes from within the meat creature, revealed to be the Wolf, begging to be killed. Bonogo stabs it and hits something unexpectedly hard inside, suggesting the Wolf may be trapped within or controlling the creature.

nodes.label: The Seed That Emanates Dark Energy
nodes.description: Stafl extracts a seed from a protrusion within the meat creature. Small tentacles wrap around his hand and dark energy tries to burrow into his skin. When stabbed, it triggers lightning and screams from all connected meat.

nodes.label: Cultists in a Trance Feed the Creature with Blood
nodes.description: A Cultist falls into a trance and walks to the center of the room, spilling blood onto the meat where it is absorbed and heals the large creature. This suggests a mind-control or ritual link between the Cultists and the creature.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:20-20

nodes.label: The Meat Creature Escapes Through the Ceiling
nodes.description: After being severed in two, the top half of the creature rips open a hole in the ceiling and escapes, leaving the storm to fade and the remaining meat creatures to die. Its ultimate destination and whether it survived remain unknown.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:36-36

the storm starts to fade, the rancid smell of meat dissipates, the remaining meat creatures die

nodes.label: Glaze Disappears from the Cultists' Eyes
nodes.description: With the creature's defeat, the glaze disappears from the remaining Cultists' eyes, implying they were under some form of control or influence that is now broken.

nodes.label: Lesandra Orders Silence About the Night's Events
nodes.description: After the battle, Lesandra appears at the front of the crowd of Cultists and orders everyone to keep quiet about the events of the night so the festival can continue as planned. Her authority and motives are unclear.

beats.title: Centipede Writhing and the Wolf's Plea
beats.summary: The centipede-like creature vibrates and drags Ephanna into the giant pile on the center platform while Bonogo clings to it; a head materializes and reveals itself as the Wolf begging to be killed, and dark energy pulses heal the creature.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:14-14
anchor_quotes: The centipede-like creature begins to vibrate, trying to shake off its adversaries.
until only Ephanna’s head remains visible
revealing itself to be the Wolf and begging to be killed
Dark energy pulses through the room and along the creature, curing a large portion of damage.

beats.title: Storm Breaks and Water Pours In
beats.summary: A flash and smell of ozone precede water pouring in from every tunnel and ceiling crack; Caelynn identifies the storm as identical to the one at Stone Bridge where Bonogo and Bubbles were nearly swept away.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:16-16

beats.title: Bonogo Stabs the Wolf and Is Launched Free
beats.summary: Bonogo stabs the Wolf's head with his dagger, hits something hard inside, and is launched 80 feet back by the centipede; Caelynn's Feather Fall saves him, and he cuts Ephanna free.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:18-18

beats.title: Cultist Falls into Trance and Sacrifices Blood
beats.summary: Caelynn slows the centipede with Ray of Frost and collects floor goo; a nearby Cultist enters a trance, reaches the center despite Stafl's hit, and spills blood onto the meat, healing the creature.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:20-20

beats.summary: Karsemine damages the tentacle, casts Zephyr Strike to escape being surrounded by Meat Mounds, and uses Horde Breaker on the nearest one.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:24-24

beats.summary: After a quick debate, Stafl stabs the seed; a crack of lightning and screams from all the connected meat signal that the meat creature has taken a critical blow.

beats.title: Tendril Severed as Party Deals Massive Damage
beats.summary: A Meat Mound hits Ephanna, who Shatters it and drinks a Greater Healing Potion; Idris severs the tendril, shaking the room, and Baergrom's Commander's Strike with Bonogo misses before a Second Wind hit.

anchor_quotes: Ephanna casts Shatter on the Meat Mound
Ephanna then downs a Greater Healing Potion, recovering almost all hit points
Idris attacks the same tendril and finally severs it
Baergrom uses Commander’s Strike with Bonogo, but the attack misses

beats.title: Walls Grapple the Climbers; Karsemine Downed
beats.summary: Meat walls grapple Bonogo and Karsemine as they hang on; Karsemine dodges but is carried up, crushed, and downed out of reach as the creature nears the ceiling.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:30-30

beats.title: Bonogo Rescues Karsemine; Creature on Last Leg
beats.summary: Caelynn casts Magic Missile on the wall holding Bonogo; Bonogo climbs to Karsemine and heals her with a potion, stabs the creature, and Karsemine and Stafl attack as the centipede nears collapse.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:32-32
anchor_quotes: Caelynn casts Magic Missile on the wall holding Bonogo
healing her with a potion

The centipede-like creature looks to be finally on its last leg

beats.title: Caelynn Downed; Ephanna Severs the Creature
beats.summary: A Meat Mound knocks Caelynn unconscious and Baergrom revives her with a potion; Ephanna's Eldritch Blast severs the creature in two.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:34-34
anchor_quotes: The Meat Mound attacks Caelynn with both attacks, dealing a massive amount of damage and knocking her unconscious
Baergrom rushes to revive her with a potion
Ephanna attacks the creature with Eldritch Blast, severing it in two!

beats.title: Final Battle Ends as Storm and Glamour Fade
beats.summary: As the creature's lower half crashes, the top half rips a hole in the ceiling; the storm fades, the meat smell dissipates, remaining meat creatures die, and the glaze leaves the Cultists' eyes, ending the final battle.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-17:0f4fb9ba1ef3:span:0f4fb9ba1ef3:36-36
anchor_quotes: the storm starts to fade, the rancid smell of meat dissipates
the remaining meat creatures die
the glaze disappears from the eyes of the remaining Cultists
Thus ending the final battle!

beats.summary: A crowd of Cultists forms around the hole with Lesandra at the front; after the party climbs back to the street, Lesandra orders everyone to keep quiet about the night's events so the festival can continue.

beats.summary: The air changes from despair to celebration while the exhausted party plans a long rest before joining the festival fun.
